_comment: Scene-keyed STT hot vocabulary. When cfg.translation.current_activity (set by scene_context) matches any keyword (case-insensitive substring), the terms are merged into the STT prompt glossary so the recognizer snaps to correct spellings. Terms chosen from observed 20260706-07 mishears (메가태화←메가진화, 파오젠, 픽생몬←포켓몬).
